paper.title_en: Complexification of the Kerr-AdS black hole thermodynamic phase transition
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we establish a systematic complex-analytical framework for investigating the thermodynamics of high-dimensional singly spinning Kerr-AdS black holes. By performing an analytical continuation of the black hole horizon radius into the complex plane, we map the thermodynamic behavior for the black hole to the zeros distribution of the corresponding analytical function. In the region below the critical point, this approach provides the criterion for identifying phase transitions and reveals that the zeroth-order phase transition does not alter the underlying thermodynamic topological structure of the black hole. In the supercritical region, based on the Lee-Yang theory of phase transition, we construct the Widom line to characterize the supercritical crossover behavior for the Kerr-AdS black holes. This study provides a new perspective on the thermodynamic analysis of black holes.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将复分析方法系统应用于高维单自旋Kerr-AdS黑洞热力学，通过视界半径的复解析延拓把热力学行为映射为解析函数的零点分布，并据此判定临界点以下的相变、讨论零阶相变对热力学拓扑结构的影响，以及在超临界区构造Widom线刻画跨临界行为。主题与黑洞热力学高度契合，理论框架完整，概念上提供了新的分析视角，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: Kerr-AdS黑洞热力学相变的复化研究
decision.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们建立了一个系统的复分析框架，用以研究高维单自旋Kerr-AdS黑洞的热力学。通过将黑洞视界半径解析延拓到复平面，我们将黑洞的热力学行为映射为相应解析函数的零点分布。在临界点以下的区域，这一方法为识别相变提供了判据，并揭示出零阶相变并不改变黑洞潜在的热力学拓扑结构。在超临界区域，基于相变的Lee-Yang理论，我们构造了Widom线以刻画Kerr-AdS黑洞的超临界跨临界行为。本研究为黑洞的热力学分析提供了一个新的视角。
